description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Grid_Bars', which extends 'Image_Graph_Grid' and is responsible for rendering alternating bar grids on a plot area within the Image_Graph PHP library. It includes methods for outputting the grid with specific visual styles, handling axis points, and drawing polygons on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid_Bars
classes.description: A class for rendering alternating bar grid lines on a plot area within the Image_Graph library.
